data.desc: Pineapple Financial Inc. is a technology-focused Canadian mortgage brokerage and fintech company. Through its Mortgage Operations, Pineapple provides mortgage origination support, proprietary technology, subscription-based software, underwriting, insurance and related financial services to mortgage professionals and consumers across Canada. During fiscal 2026, Pineapple expanded its business to include Digital Asset Operations as part of its broader treasury and capital-allocation strategy, creating two complementary operating platforms.
